name: Olee Sleep 10 Inch Gel Infused Layer Top Memory Foam Mattress (Full Size)
description: Olee Sleep 10-inch gel-infused layer top memory foam mattress in Full size (Model: 10FM01F). Features a multi-layer breathable foam structure including cooling gel memory foam that regulates sleeping temperature and disperses body heat. Designed with convoluted high-density support layers to adapt to body contour, isolating motion and relieving pressure points. Wrapped in a premium jacquard protective cover. Fully complies with federal flammability standard 16 CFR Part 1633. Clean, well-maintained, and works perfectly on platform bases or frames. Selling cheap for graduation moving sale!
name_zh: Olee Sleep 10英寸凝胶记忆棉双人床垫 (Full Size)
